title: Crisp Map Builder sheets (pdf.js like Viewer)
description:
Map Building sheets looked soft when zoomed in because they were native browser PDF iframes scaled with CSS (including the ~2.8× layout scale). PDF Viewer stays sharp because it re-renders pdf.js canvases at each zoom.

Map Builder now uses the same pdf.js canvas path: sheets re-rasterize as you zoom, with a screen-pixel floor that includes layout display scale and a higher oversample. Text may briefly look soft for a moment while a sheet re-paints, then match Viewer clarity.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync after deploy.
changeLog: Map Builder sheets use pdf.js canvas instead of native PDF iframes.
Re-rasterize map sheets on zoom with a display-scale-aware screen-pixel floor.
Raise map oversample so deep zoom stays crisp like the PDF Viewer.
